title: Hinomori Shizuku — Fun With Layout Planning〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Can you tell me how this looks...?
I tried working in Shizuku's suggestions...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay!
Let's do this segment during our next stream!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, this means we can finally...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We can start thinking about the MORE MORE HOUSE's interior design.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! I brought a bunch of sample images with me. They're all really cute designs!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also found a couple pieces of furniture that might come in handy. I'm sure we'll be able to make good use of them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, settle down. I know you're excited, but we have to check the floor plan again first...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you wrote in all the measurements we took.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's pretty crucial for this step of the process. And feel free to jot down as many notes as you like. I've made plenty of copies for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Shiho! We've made ourselves at home!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have tea and snacks for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's so kind of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mom suggested it when I went to get some tea...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's munch on these while we talk.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This room's got a big window that lets in lots of light. We could turn it into sort of a reception room by putting in a coffee table and a couple sofas.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and we can use it as a place to relax when we're not entertaining guests.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, lemme jot down your idea for this room!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What if we put in a room divider here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The office in this picture is about the same size as the house. Notice how their meeting space is partitioned off?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, we might need to set certain areas apart.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case!
What if we used some of these racks as dividers?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's another idea to keep in mind! They'd act as room dividers while also giving us a place to put cute decorations. Two birds with one stone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We came up with all these ideas in no time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's really easy to imagine what it'll be like living there!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're talking about that advice to pick a place we can see ourselves living in, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, my mind couldn't help but come up with a few different scenarios.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? That light's flickering.
Is it on its last legs?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have spares, but I won't be able to reach even if I stand on a chair. What do I do?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku?! You'll do it for me?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! I should be able to reach it by standing on this chair!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Shizuku!
I can already see that happening in real life!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'd just barely be able to reach if I hopped while on top of a chair!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's what caught your attention...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That sounds dangerous, so Shizuku or I will try to take care of those things...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, how about we send pictures of our layout ideas over to Saito?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good call.
We should definitely see what she thinks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to hearing her opinion. Which idea do you think she'll like the most?
